Press Build all and the server puts your plan into the world piece by piece without stalling. Changed your mind? Undo build takes everything back out. Now it is your turn.
Here you plan whole houses before a single plank goes down. Everything stays blue and harmless until you press Build all. This page explains every tool, every key and every icon.

As soon as the planner is open, you turn into an invisible ghost. W, A, S and D glide you through walls, Page Up and Page Down change the level, Home takes you back to your plan. Close the planner and you stand exactly where you started.

On the left sits the catalog: floors, walls, frames, fences, stairs, roofs and furniture, including the tiles of your other mods. The search filters everything at once. One click on a piece and it is in your hand.

The tools wait at the top. The brush paints tile by tile, the line draws a straight row, the area fills a rectangle, the fill bucket floods a whole room and the eraser takes things away again. R rotates, Ctrl and Z undoes.
Pick a wall and drag with the area tool: you get the complete outline of a room. Door and window frames go straight into the wall. Take your time, nothing is built yet.

Below the toolbar sits the level bar. The up arrow takes you one level higher. Take over the floor puts the walls and floors of the level below right on top again. That is how a house grows floor by floor.

You find stairs in the catalog. One click sets the foot, R turns them. The floor above becomes the opening by itself. Put the stairs one level below ground and you have a cellar entrance in the middle of your garden.

Roofs sit one level above your walls. Pick a roof piece from the catalog and place it with the brush or the area tool. Every roof colour has its own pieces for slope, corner and ridge, the search helps you find them.

If you like your design, save it as a blueprint. Later you stamp it anywhere with one click, all levels included. Three examples are already waiting: a cabin, a house with an upper floor and a cellar entrance.
